accountNeeds: to have booked something online before — an account was created for you when you did.

guides.title: Logging in and using the dashboard
points: Log in with your Active Sefton account — the same email and password you use to book online.
Never set a password for your account? Use “Forgotten password” with the email we have for you, and you’ll be sent a link to set one.

guides.title: Making a booking and cancelling
points: Book classes and activities straight from the app.
If a booking didn’t need paying for, you can cancel it yourself in the app. If you can’t make a class, please cancel — it frees your place for someone on the waiting list.
For paid bookings, cancellations and refunds are handled by the centre you booked with, so get in touch with them.

guides.title: Booking for more than one person
points: Add other people when you book swimming, Splash World and more.
When you’re logged in you’re included in the group automatically. Switch yourself off if you’re booking just for others.
Confirm the group, pay, and your booking is confirmed.
